messages:
marie_onboard: Heads up — starting a small rollout to tie onboarding feedback -> healthscore decay and reactivation playbook. Goal: if NPS <= 3 within 30 days, reduce healthscore by 20 pts, trigger re-engagement sequence, and trigger owner reassignment after 7 days of no activity. Draft rule below; please review before I wire to prod.

```yaml
name: onboarding_nps_reactivation
trigger: nps_received
conditions:
  - nps_score: <= 3
  - days_since_signup: <= 30
actions:
  - adjust_healthscore: -20
  - start_playbook: onboarding_reengage_sequence
  - if: no_activity_days >= 7
    then:
      - reassign_owner: auto_pool
      - add_contact_note: "auto-reassign triggered by low NPS + inactivity"
      - webhook: /revops/nps_audit
skip_if: owner_lock == true
```

diego_ops: Looks straightforward. Two quick Qs: how are we defining `no_activity_days` (last touch event from telemetry?), and does `owner_lock` come from CRM owner-level metadata or internal CS flag? @kevin_cs

kevin_cs: Use `last_company_touch` from telemetry + messaging events (email/seq engagement). For `owner_lock` use the CRM owner field `fields.owner_lock` — if true we skip reassignment. Also add an audit write to contact_history so we have a trail. sgtm otherwise.

sara_revops: Can we persist `nps_source` and `nps_comment` into CRM custom fields as well? We'll want to slice by survey channel later (in-app vs email). If not possible, we'll capture raw payload in the webhook.

marie_onboard: Yes — we'll map to `nps_source` and `nps_text` fields. playbook-bot will POST to our ingest webhook: `https://hooks.redwood/revops/nps_ingest`. Example quick curl to test: `curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/revops/nps_ingest -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"account_id":"ACCT-123","nps":2,"source":"in-app","comment":"onboarding confusion"}'`

playbook-bot: Playbook rule validated in staging — 3 tests passed. Recommend deploy path: canary (5 accounts) -> monitor 48h -> full roll. Use `--dry-run` for initial checks, `--force` to commit.

jenna_engineer: I'll add the `owner_lock` check and the audit write to contact_history table. ETA: tomorrow AM, will push a small PR and link the change here. tagging infra for rollout hooks: @diego_ops

diego_ops: Perfect. Plan: canary to 5 accounts, watch healthscore delta and reassign rate. If <5% noisy reassigns and no negative support volume, roll to 100 accounts then full. Scheduling canary for Thu 9:00 AM PT. :calendar:

kevin_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll draft the owner-facing message and recovery play steps (call cadence, checklist) and share in #cs-ops later today. :thumbsup:
